name: The Orb of Soran'ruk
summary: In the southern Barrens, Doan Karhan gathers warlocks around the broken Orb of Soran'ruk. They seek to restore the scattered pieces and the essence bound within.

sections.title: Vessels of the Disgraced
sections.body: When lesser demons lose favor with the Burning Legion, their sentence is eternal. Their spirits are bound in crystal orbs and given to mortal conjurers and warlocks as vessels of power under demonic control. Shattering an orb does not free its captive. Even the shards keep potent magic.

sections.title: Scattered Across Continents
sections.body:
Pieces of Soran'ruk lie across two continents. Twilight's Hammer cultists hold smaller fragments in the damp caverns of Blackfathom Deeps in Ashenvale. A sorcerer in the haunted ruins of Shadowfang Keep in Silverpine Forest claimed the larger, mostly intact half.

Doan Karhan has spent his life studying Legion orbs and assembled the Orb of Zargain before. With the recovered pieces, he can restore Soran'ruk as a working implement.

faq.q: What is the Orb of Soran'ruk?
faq.answer: Soran'ruk was a demon of the Burning Legion who fell out of favor. By demonic custom, its spirit was imprisoned in a magical orb and given to mortal practitioners. The orb was later shattered, but its fragments still hold the demon's power.

Doan Karhan is a reclusive warlock who lives in the southern Barrens. He has devoted his life to studying and rebuilding the Burning Legion's orbs. After many years assembling the Orb of Zargain, he helps new warlocks piece together Soran'ruk.

faq.q: Why is the orb broken across two different dungeons?
aliases: why are pieces in bfd and sfk
faq.answer: The orb was split into two main pieces. Twilight's Hammer cultists hold smaller fragments in Blackfathom Deeps, while a wizard claimed the larger remnant in Shadowfang Keep.

aliases: is orb of soranruk warlock only
faq.answer: Warlocks seeking to advance their craft and master implements made from imprisoned demonic spirits can pursue this rite.

faq.q: What does Doan Karhan do with the recovered fragments?
faq.answer: Doan Karhan studies the recovered fragments to further his research into Legion relics. Then he rebuilds them as a magical implement shaped to the warlock's choosing.

faq.q: What is the Orb of Zargain?
faq.answer: The Orb of Zargain is a prison for a demon of the Legion who fell out of favor. Doan Karhan tracked it down and spent many years rebuilding it for his own use.

angles.text: As a warlock, rebuilding Soran'ruk marks a major milestone in your craft. You learn how the Legion disciplines its own kind and how bound demons can be harnessed in working implements.
As a member of the Horde, you can find Doan Karhan in the harsh southern Barrens. Traveling conjurers come to these plains seeking advanced dark lore.
